page.content:
NetherRealm's tournament saga — Earthrealm, Outworld, and the champions between them.

How Mortal Kombat connects

  • Event: Mortal Kombat tournament — The tournament is the contest the whole saga is named for.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Mortal Kombat (1992) is the arcade game that began the saga.
  • Location: Earthrealm — Earthrealm is the human world the tournament is meant to protect.
  • Location: Outworld — Outworld is the imperial realm that treats Mortal Kombat as conquest.
  • Concept: Fatalities — Fatalities are the finishing murders the series is known for.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 1 — Mortal Kombat 1 is the 2023 timeline reboot.
  • Location: Netherrealm — The Netherrealm is the hell that forges specters in Mortal Kombat.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat 11 — Mortal Kombat 11 is a later NetherRealm chapter of the saga.

What is Mortal Kombat?

Mortal Kombat is the fighting saga in which realms settle conquest through a named tournament. Its lore runs through Liu Kang, Raiden, the Lin Kuei and Shirai Ryu, Shao Kahn's Outworld, and the 1992 arcade game that made fatalities famous.

Key threads lead to Mortal Kombat tournament, Mortal Kombat (1992), Earthrealm, Outworld, Fatalities and Mortal Kombat 1.
